map.计算间接胆红素及直接胆红素比值，辅助鉴别黄疸类型: Calculate indirect bilirubin and the direct bilirubin ratio to help differentiate jaundice types.
map.胆管结石、胆管癌、胰头癌: Bile duct stones, cholangiocarcinoma, pancreatic head cancer
map.直接胆红素比值 = DBIL / TBIL × 100%。间接胆红素 = TBI: Direct bilirubin ratio = DBIL / TBIL × 100%. Indirect bilirubin = TBIL - DBIL.
map.Gilbert综合征：轻度升高（＜85 μmol/L），遗传性: Gilbert syndrome: mild elevation (<85 μmol/L), hereditary
map.有效肝细胞摄取障碍：心衰、药物等: Impaired hepatocyte uptake: heart failure, drugs, etc.
map.胆管梗阻：结石、肿瘤、狭窄（影像学确诊）: Biliary obstruction: stones, tumor, stricture (confirmed by imaging)
map.提示：胆红素比值仅作为黄疸鉴别初筛，确诊需结合ALT/AST、ALP、GGT、影: Note: The bilirubin ratio is only an initial screening aid for differentiating jaundice; confirmation requires ALT/AST, ALP, GGT, and imaging (ultrasound/MRCP) judged together. In Gilbert syndrome, indirect bilirubin can rise further after fasting or stress. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：胆红素（直接/间接）比值与黄疸类型鉴别: 📚 Deep Dive: Bilirubin (Direct/Indirect) Ratio and Jaundice Type Differentiation
map.黄疸查因：由总胆红素与直接胆红素算直接胆红素比值，区分溶血性/肝细胞性/梗阻性: Finding the cause of jaundice: compute the direct bilirubin ratio from total and direct bilirubin to separate hemolytic / hepatocellular / obstructive
map.随访监测：肝胆疾病治疗中观察 DBIL/TBIL 比值变化判断病程走向: Follow-up monitoring: track changes in the DBIL/TBIL ratio during hepatobiliary treatment to judge disease course
map.体检解读：单项胆红素轻度升高时快速区分 Gilbert 综合征与胆汁淤积: Health-check interpretation: quickly separate Gilbert syndrome from cholestasis when a single bilirubin item is mildly elevated
map.算法：间接胆红素 IBIL = TBIL − DBIL；直接胆红素比值 = DB: Algorithm: indirect bilirubin IBIL = TBIL − DBIL; direct bilirubin ratio = DBIL/TBIL×100% (capped at TBIL when DBIL>TBIL). Decision: TBIL≤reference (default 21 μmol/L) is normal; ratio <20% suggests indirect-predominant elevation (hemolysis/Gilbert); 20%~35% mixed (leaning hemolytic); 35%~60% hepatocellular jaundice; >60% obstructive jaundice (direct-predominant). Common differentiation directions and suggested tests (LDH, reticulocytes, Coombs, hepatitis markers, ALP/GGT, CA19-9, MRCP, etc.) are listed alongside.
map.例：TBIL 85μmol/L、DBIL 55μmol/L、参考值 21μmol: Example: TBIL 85 μmol/L, DBIL 55 μmol/L, reference 21 μmol/L → IBIL 30 μmol/L, direct bilirubin ratio 64.7%, judged obstructive jaundice (direct-predominant); ultrasound/MRCP is advised soon to localize the obstruction. If TBIL 120 μmol/L, DBIL 18 μmol/L → ratio 15.0%, judged indirect-predominant elevation (hemolytic/Gilbert); check LDH, reticulocytes, Coombs test, and UGT1A1 genotyping to exclude Gilbert syndrome.
map.比值>60% 就一定需要手术吗？: Does a ratio >60% always require surgery?
map.比值只提示胆汁淤积以直接胆红素为主，常见于胆管结石、胆管癌、胰头癌或肝内胆汁淤积: The ratio only indicates cholestasis with direct bilirubin predominating, common in bile duct stones, cholangiocarcinoma, pancreatic head cancer, or intrahepatic cholestasis, but it cannot by itself decide the treatment plan. ALP/GGT, abdominal imaging (ultrasound/MRCP/CT), and tumor markers must be judged together, and hepatobiliary surgery or gastroenterology determines whether to intervene.
map.Gilbert 综合征是 UGT1A1 酶活性部分缺陷导致的良性遗传性高胆红素血: Gilbert syndrome is a benign hereditary hyperbilirubinemia caused by partial deficiency of UGT1A1 enzyme activity, featuring mild indirect-predominant elevation with normal liver function and good prognosis, and generally needs no treatment. The key is to distinguish it from pathological elevation such as hemolysis or hepatitis, avoiding excessive testing.
